title: Jeanine with Birthday Cake, Clamshell Chair - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet mid-century snapshot featuring a smiling young girl named Jeanine sitting outside on a sunny patio. In front of her on a round umbrella table sits a heavily frosted homemade birthday or celebration cake, along with a fork, bread, and a divided plate. She is seated in a classic vintage scalloped metal clamshell lawn chair in the shaded yard. The photograph has traditional decorative scalloped deckled edges characteristic of mid-1950s family photo prints.
